title: SunPath Solar Lease Buyout and Early Exit Schedule
content:
SunPath Solar Lease figures for buying the system, transferring the lease on a sale of the home, ending the lease early and moving the system, by system size.

## Buyout and transfer figures

| Tier | Buyout available after | Buyout price at the start of lease year six | Yearly decline of the buyout price after lease year six | Transfer processing time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SunPath 3.2 kW | 60 months from permission to operate | $9800.00 | 6 percent | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 4.0 kW | 60 months from permission to operate | $12100.00 | 6 percent | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 4.8 kW | 60 months from permission to operate | $14300.00 | 6 percent | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 5.6 kW | 60 months from permission to operate | $16500.00 | 6 percent | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 6.4 kW | 60 months from permission to operate | $18700.00 | 6 percent | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 8.0 kW | 60 months from permission to operate | $23200.00 | 6 percent | 30 calendar days |

- **Buyout available after** — the number of months after the permission-to-operate date after which the lessee may buy the system.
- **Buyout price at the start of lease year six** — the buyout price in US dollars at the start of lease year six.
- **Yearly decline** — the yearly decline of the buyout price after lease year six, in percent.
- **Transfer processing time** — the number of calendar days to process a lease transfer.

## Early termination and relocation

| Tier | Early termination without a transfer or buyout | System may be moved to another home |
|---|---|---|
| SunPath 3.2 kW | Not allowed | No |
| SunPath 4.0 kW | Not allowed | No |
| SunPath 4.8 kW | Not allowed | No |
| SunPath 5.6 kW | Not allowed | No |
| SunPath 6.4 kW | Not allowed | No |
| SunPath 8.0 kW | Not allowed | No |

- **Early termination** — whether the lessee may terminate the lease early without a transfer or buyout. No size allows it.
- **Relocation** — whether the system may be moved to another home. No size allows it.

## Note on the buyout price column

The buyout price differs by size, from $9800.00 for the SunPath 3.2 kW system to $23200.00 for the SunPath 8.0 kW system; the 60-month waiting period, the 6 percent yearly decline and the 30-day transfer processing time are common to all sizes.
